description: An oil-painted night scene of a cluttered wooden desk in a dim room. An open metal index-card box sits on the left, a black manual typewriter with a sheet in it sits center, and a black rotary telephone is at right. A revolver, a coffee mug, loose papers and an ashtray lie on the desk. Through a window with venetian blinds, palm trees and street lamps line a dark beach road, with the sea beyond. No people are visible.
